dish: Asahikawa shōyu ramen with seafood + pork 'double soup' (since 1947)
n: Asahikawa Rāmen Aoba Honten (旭川らぅめん青葉 本店)
address: Nijō Bldg Meitengai 1F, Nijō-dōri 8-chōme, Asahikawa, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A 1947 original kept by its third-generation master — the Asahikawa double soup of sea and land stocks in a lard-sealed shōyu bowl.

n: Miso Rāmen no Yoshino Honten (みそラーメンのよし乃 本店)
w: The trailblazer of Asahikawa miso ramen, miso-only since the day it opened.

n: Curry no Furanoya (カレーのふらのや)
w: A log-house curry shop near Furano Station with soup and roux curries built on local vegetables — a Furano lunch queue.

n: Kashi Kōbō Furano Delice (菓子工房フラノデリス)
w: A hillside patisserie using Furano milk and eggs — the bottled Furano milk pudding has sold out since day one; twenty-plus cakes daily.
